title: The leading term of the Euler characteristic of a coherent module twisted by invertible sheaves is given by the lengths at the generic points of the top-dimensional components
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter varieties.tex, section on numerical intersections
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file varieties.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The lemma computes the top-degree behaviour of chi(X, F tensor L_1^{n_1} tensor ... tensor L_r^{n_r}): the difference from the sum of m_i chi(Z_i, L^{n}|_{Z_i}) over the top-dimensional components of the support is a numerical polynomial of total degree strictly less than d = dim Supp(F). The proof recasts the expression as a functional E(F) over integral closed subschemes, proves additivity of E along short exact sequences using additivity of Euler characteristics and of lengths, filters F by subsheaves whose subquotients are pushed-forward ideal sheaves on integral subschemes, reduces to those subquotients, and handles the middle term by the projection formula with the identification of the cohomology of a closed immersion pushforward (proof lines 10311-10385). H3: the reduction through the coherent filtration together with the length-weighted bookkeeping is an independent research-level argument.
